title: Everyone Is an Artist (designMode)
summary: The browser's whole-document edit mode makes the label, licence and artist's signature all editable by the viewer, then forgets it on reload.
mechanism: document.designMode='on' grants everyone edit rights over the entire document with zero event handlers and no persistence
references: Joseph Beuys, Jeder Mensch ist ein Kunstler / Soziale Plastik (social sculpture)
Roland Barthes, The Death of the Author (1967)
y-a-v-a, The Death of the Author (2026)
